# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## What exists

- Name: `identify` refuses an account with no own profile as `name-needed`; pages send it to
  `/account?next=` (S-125). `give-own-name.ts`, `change-own-name.ts`; browser tests use the
  kit's `answerNameScreen`. No name: `local-unnamed-token` (T-447); the member is named.
- Password (T-451, T-452, S-127): `changePassword` (old one counted as `confirmPassword`'s
  guesses, other sessions ended); `change-own-password.ts`, `change-password-form.tsx`.
- Email (T-455, T-457, T-458, T-461, S-129): `startEmailChange`, `confirmEmailChange`; the
  waiting change is ours, `sign_in.email_changes` (0031, one row per account, code hashed
  over account, address and code); Supabase moves the address with one `PUT /admin/users`
  (`setUserEmail`). `start-own-email-change.ts`, `confirm-own-email-change.ts`, port
  `ownEmail`. A new password drops a waiting change (L2).
